name: UvRun
description: Run one or several uv commands (sync, pip install, run, tool run...)
helpMarkDown: Run one or several uv commands (sync, pip install, run, tool run...)
author: Henry Daniel Mosquera

inputs.name: commands
inputs.label: uv commands
inputs.helpMarkDown: One uv command per line, without the leading `uv` (it is accepted and ignored). Lines starting with `#` are comments. Single or double quotes group arguments. Example: `sync --frozen`, `pip install "ruff>=0.5"`, `run pytest`.

inputs.name: failOnError
inputs.label: Stop on first error
inputs.helpMarkDown: Stop at the first command with a non-zero exit code and fail the task. When off, every command runs and the task finishes with warnings if any failed.

inputs.name: env
inputs.label: Extra environment (KEY=VALUE)
inputs.helpMarkDown: One KEY=VALUE per line. Useful for UV_INDEX_URL, UV_CACHE_DIR, UV_NO_CACHE...

inputs.name: autoInstallUv
inputs.label: Install uv if missing
inputs.helpMarkDown: If uv is not found, download it (same logic as the UvSetup task). Disable on locked-down agents and run UvSetup / pre-bake uv instead.

inputs.name: uvVersion
inputs.label: uv version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Only used when uv has to be installed. `latest` or an exact version such as `0.8.0`.

outputVariables.name: exitCode
outputVariables.description: 0 if every command succeeded, otherwise the exit code of the first failing command
